# PGAK — AI CCTV Intelligence for Indian Businesses

> PGAK (PGAK Innovations Pvt. Ltd., Ludhiana, Punjab, India) turns the CCTV
> cameras a business already owns into an intelligent monitoring system:
> intruder detection, face-recognition attendance, false-alarm filtering,
> loitering detection and vehicle/ANPR — with alerts on the owner's phone.
> No new cameras or hardware are required; the software runs on existing
> CCTV/DVR setups via RTSP.

## Pricing (canonical)

- Flat rate: ₹1,000 per camera per month, across India.
- No hardware cost, no licence fee, no per-feature add-ons, no lock-in.
- Enterprise/multi-site: custom volume pricing.
- Details: https://www.pgak.co.in/pricing
- Cost guide: https://www.pgak.co.in/insights/ai-cctv-price-in-india-what-it-should-cost
